parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: $PQ$ is vertical ($x = 2$) and $QR$ is horizontal ($y = 5$) $\implies \angle PQR = 90^\circ \implies PR$ is a diameter
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Notes that $P(2, -1)$ and $Q(2, 5)$ share $x = 2$ (vertical), and $Q(2, 5)$ and $R(10, 5)$ share $y = 5$ (horizontal). — M1
Concludes $\angle PQR = 90^\circ$, hence by the converse of Thales's theorem $PR$ is a diameter. — A1
